description: Add a news source to the user's account, so its articles show up in list_news and feed news posts. Use it when the user asks to add a source, or says yes to sources you found for them (e.g. with web_search) — add them one call each instead of asking the user to copy the addresses into settings. source can be an RSS/Atom feed URL, a website or news page address (the feed is found automatically; a site without one is scanned), a YouTube channel, a subreddit (r/name), a Substack/Medium address or a podcast. Only add sources the user asked for or agreed to. status 'scanning' means it is NOT added yet — say so and try again in a few minutes.

name.description: Optional display name; defaults to the feed's own title

source.description: Feed URL, site address, YouTube channel, subreddit or podcast

name: add_news_source
title: Add News Source
